The '''second commander''' of [[Triton Squad]] was a [[clone stormtrooper]] [[Cloning/Legends|conceived]] from the progenitor [[Clone template/Legends|genetic template]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. Originally hardwired and genetically engineered to become an indistinct [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], he subsequently became a 501st [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Imperial stormtrooper]] following the Republic's [[Declaration of a New Order|reformation]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by the [[19 BBY/Legends|end]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. By the time of the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (c. 18 BBY)|Imperial invasion]] of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Homeworld/Legends|home planet]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] and his [[Squad/Legends|squad]] were assigned to the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], an [[elite]] [[Division/Legends|division]] of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] under the command of the [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].

==Biography==
During the early [[Imperial Era/Legends|period]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Triton Squad]]&mdash;including its [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]]&mdash;was deployed with the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] after the [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]],<ref name="kenner">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (toy line)|pack=Darth Vader vs. Prince Xizor|link=soteKxizor-vader.asp}}</ref> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], discovered that a [[Order 66/Legends|fugitive]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] was being sheltered by the local altruistic [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] population. The [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial invasion force]] was met with heavy resistance from the Wookiees, igniting a [[Battle of Kashyyyk (c. 18 BBY)|battle]] in which both sides suffered heavy casualties. Shortly after arriving on Kashyyyk, [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Vader encountered Triton [[Squad/Legends|Squad]] just after they [[Death/Legends|vaporized]] a company of armed Wookiee warriors. Reporting for duty, the commander and his [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] fervently accompanied the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] during his [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|hunt]] for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kento Marek]].<ref name="TFU" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Yes, sir. You heard him, men, on the double.|The Commander, relaying Darth Vader's order to Triton Squad|<ref name="TFU" />}}
The Commander of Triton Squad was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="TFU" /> and thus stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] like his [[Clone template/Legends|genetic template]]. Bred to be obedient to the [[Imperial High Command/Legends|chain of command]],<ref name="Origins" /> the Commander was a loyal [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who carried out orders from the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader unquestionably, even during situations of extreme uneasiness and distress thereof.<ref name="TFU" />

==Equipment==
While serving on Kashyyyk, the Commander wore an early version of [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]], customized with the notable [[Color/Legends|blue]] design that the 501st Legion utilized during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. His [[Armor/Legends|armor]] was also equipped with a command [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]] and [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]]. He was armed with the standard [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]].<ref name="TFU" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Commander of Triton Squad appeared in the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PlayStation 2]] and [[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]] versions of the [[2008]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''. He is not seen, however, in the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]] and [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions.<ref name="TFU" />
